items.title: What's News in Markets: Nvidia's Next Chapter, CoreWeave's Bullish Backlog, Microsoft's Glitch
items.take: Saturday's markets edition sets up next week: Nvidia's first print under interim CEO Colette Kress, with analysts looking for about $125 billion in January-quarter guidance and answers on succession and China. Anthropic's IPO prices next week too, up to $1.4 trillion.

items.title: Stock market today: Dow rises, S&P 500 and Nasdaq slip to cap volatile week, Nvidia stock plunge deepens
items.take: Friday split the indexes: the Dow rose while the S&P and Nasdaq slipped, capping a volatile week of rising yields, an oil spike and the Nvidia turmoil. Retail investors were reportedly there to catch Nvidia's fall, and the 10-year touched 5.17%, its highest since October.

items.title: Bulls and Bears: Nvidia's sixth straight weekly decline
items.take: Nvidia fell about 13% from the previous Friday's close, a sixth consecutive weekly decline, while the broader market stayed relatively resilient. Tesla had its best five-day rally since September 2025, adding roughly $218 billion in market value as Musk pushes for a SpaceX merger by December.

items.title: What Nvidia losing its founder did to stocks. The week on Wall Street
items.take: The week in one look: Nvidia dropped as much as 14% at Thursday's open, closed down 4.3%, and ended the week down about 13%. Traders treat a December hike as near certainty, up from about 80% odds a week ago, with an 11% chance of a half-point move.

items.title: Nasdaq Snaps a Four-Week Slide, Up 2.3%, as Nvidia's CEO Resigns
items.take: Despite the drama, the Nasdaq snapped a four-week slide and finished up 2.3%, with the S&P up about 2.5%. October PPI came in at +0.3% versus +0.4% expected, but its 6.5% annual rise is the largest since November 2022, keeping the Fed hawkish into Wednesday's FOMC minutes.
